connections.title: Registered gateways
connections.intro: Manage this device and every Hermes gateway it can reach through remote, SSH, or Cloud connections.
connections.stagedNote: Switch gateways from Sessions. Profiles, chats, messaging, and cron jobs stay with their gateway; work on other gateways keeps running.
connections.launchModeTitle: At startup, return to Sessions on the last-used gateway
connections.launchModeDesc: When off, Sessions opens on the Primary gateway.
connections.removeConfirmDesc: “{label}” will be removed from this app. The instance itself is not touched — you can add it again any time.
connections.kindLocalDesc: The Hermes runtime managed by this app.
connections.kindRemoteDesc: A Hermes gateway reachable over HTTP(S) — LAN, Tailscale, or the internet.
connections.kindCloudDesc: A hosted instance discovered through your Hermes Cloud account.
connections.kindSshDesc: A Hermes install reached over SSH.
connections.labelDesc: Required. Shown everywhere this instance appears; must be unique (e.g. “Homelab”, “Work laptop”).
connections.headersDesc: Sent with every HTTP and WebSocket request to this gateway — for access proxies such as Cloudflare Access (CF-Access-Client-Id / CF-Access-Client-Secret). Values are stored encrypted. Headers Hermes manages (Authorization, Cookie, Host…) are ignored.
connections.duplicateLocal: This app already manages a local connection — there can only be one.
connections.duplicateUrl: A connection to this gateway URL already exists (“{label}”).
connections.duplicateSsh: A connection to this SSH host already exists (“{label}”).
connections.localAddHint: Local is unavailable: the managed local connection already exists (there is only ever one).
connections.cloudAddHint: Tip: signing in under Hermes Cloud above discovers your agents automatically — use this form only to register a known instance URL by hand.
